test_crossloop_cache_isolation: test the _get_cached_client function returns different AsyncOpenAI clients when called from different event loops
test_same_loop_reuses_client: test that _get_cached_client returns the same cached client within a single event loop
test_different_loops_get_different_clien: test that _get_cached_client returns separate client instances for different event loops across threads
test_sync_clients_not_affected: test that sync clients (async_mode=False) are cached globally and shared across threads
test_gateway_simulation_no_deadlock: test that gateway mode with asyncio.run in a worker thread gets a separate cached client to avoid httpx deadlocks
